$comment: Things that are known-broken, deliberately not fixed yet, and must AGE.
This file exists because a warning that repeats forever stops being read.
mcp.integramarkets.app has had no TLS certificate since 2026-09-08. Every
check reported it, every report said 'known issue', and three days passed
with nobody deciding anything. A permanent WARN is indistinguishable from
So each entry carries a deadline. scripts/verify-production.mjs reads this
file: before `escalateAfterDays` an entry is a WARN, after it the run FAILS
and prints `nextAction`. The scheduled workflow then goes red — not because
anything new broke, but because a decision is overdue.
To silence an entry you either fix it and delete it, or change the deadline
on purpose, which is a visible act in a diff rather than a slow drift.
`verifiedNotOurs` is what has already been ruled out, so the same checks are
not repeated every time someone new looks at it.

issues.summary: The App Store app has never been built from main
issues.impact: Every mobile change needs deciding which lineage it belongs to. A build from main would ship without the paywall and could not resolve its own imports.
issues.symptom: main is missing 49 commits of mobile work; five files the shipped app imports do not exist there.
issues.nextAction: Merge the shipped mobile lineage (build64-exact) into main, deliberately and not under release pressure. Until then `npm run where` tells you which side a checkout is on.
issues.workaround: Build and OTA only from the shipped lineage.
